Native camera actions traverse live NCollection_Sequence zoom nodes, copying only the current scroll value before virtual callbacks. Current Rust snapshots the whole zoom sequence into a Vec, so valid callback append/remove-other-node edits cannot affect later traversal. Existing concrete camera-action fixtures remain valid; actual Source callback mutation requires a detached live cursor and shared buffer storage.
